title: Did a man drown because of the square root of 2?
description:
The Pythagoreans believed everything is number – any two lengths form a ratio of whole numbers. Then the diagonal of a square proved them wrong. What the sources really say about Hippasus of Metapontum, and what is only legend.

One true story from the history of math – every day.
Created with AI assistance (animation and voice); facts from the sources listed.

Sources:
· Iamblichos, Über das pythagoreische Leben (De vita Pythagorica)
· Pappos, Kommentar zum 10. Buch von Euklids Elementen
· NRICH, Hippasus Overboard (University of Cambridge)
· J. Ferreirós, What was poor Hippasus' sin? (Universidad de Sevilla, 2017)
